intro: Week 7 opens with the Eagles without Jalen Hurts, the Ravens waiting on Lamar Jackson's ankle and the Steelers and Saints getting ready for a 9:30 a.m. kickoff in Paris. Four teams are on bye, and the 5-0 Vikings and 6-0 49ers both put their records on the line. 160 stories across all 32 teams.

top.label: Biggest Story
top.headline: Eagles place Jalen Hurts on injured reserve
top.dek: Hurts has a superficial blood clot in his calf, and Tanner McKee takes over a team that has lost four straight. NFL.com reported he would miss at least a month, while the AP says he is expected to miss the rest of the season. Philadelphia hosts Dallas on Monday night.

top.label: Injury Watch
top.headline: Lamar Jackson is questionable for the Bengals
top.dek: Jackson practiced on a limited basis all week with an ankle injury and will be a game-time decision. Tyler Huntley started the loss in Cleveland last week. A second straight division loss would leave Baltimore 0-2 in the AFC North.

top.label: Player Spotlight
top.headline: Kenneth Walker leads the league with 665 rushing yards
top.dek: Walker has six touchdowns on 106 carries through five games, about 6.3 yards a carry. He ran for 128 yards and two scores against the Chargers last Sunday. Now he returns to Seattle with the unbeaten Chiefs.

top.label: Stat of the Day
top.headline: -0.190: the Chargers' EPA per play, last in the NFL
top.dek: The 0-6 Chargers sit behind even the 31st-ranked Titans and average 15.0 points a game. They settled for field goals on both trips inside the 20 in the 22-6 loss at Kansas City. Los Angeles has a bye this week to fix it.

top.label: What's Next
top.headline: Steelers and Saints meet in Paris on Sunday morning
top.dek: Pittsburgh and New Orleans play at Stade de France, with kickoff at 9:30 a.m. ET on NFL Network. The Steelers bring a two-game win streak, and the Saints bring a 2-4 record and owner pressure. Four more teams are on bye.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.headline: Bills tie Kelly's TD mark, then hit the bye

stories.text: Allen ties Jim Kelly's franchise TD pass record
stories.summary: Josh Allen threw two touchdown passes in the 33-30 win at Las Vegas on Oct. 18. His 12-yard score to Keon Coleman in the third quarter tied Kelly's Bills record of 258. Buffalo is 5-1 and goes into the bye on a two-game win streak.

stories.text: Moore and Oliver get extra rest during the bye
stories.summary: WR DJ Moore (AC joint sprain) and DT Ed Oliver (knee) missed the last two games and are working back. Bradley Chubb hurt his ribs at Las Vegas and played 21 of 66 snaps, and Dalton Kincaid had torso discomfort but returned. Allen called the team fairly healthy heading into the break.

stories.text: James Cook delivers the go-ahead score in Vegas
stories.summary: Cook ran for 95 yards with no turnovers and caught three passes for 58 yards against the Raiders. His 3-yard touchdown run with 4:43 left put Buffalo ahead for good. Tyler Bass added a 38-yard field goal with 1:56 to play.

stories.text: 1,792: passing yards the Bills defense has allowed
stories.summary: That is the most in the NFL through six games, per StatMuse figures cited by Athlon. Buffalo gives up 28.5 points a game. Cornerback Maxwell Hairston carries a 36.4 PFF coverage grade, 98th among 102 qualifiers.

stories.text: Bye in Week 7, then Ravens at home Nov. 1
stories.summary: Buffalo is off this Sunday. It hosts Baltimore at Highmark Stadium on Nov. 1. Lamar Jackson has missed two straight games with an ankle injury, and the Ravens lost 13-10 at Cleveland last week. Watch whether the Bills can tighten a pass defense that Zay Flowers (471 receiving yards) will test.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.headline: Winless Miami has not led once this season

stories.text: Dolphins have yet to lead in 293 offensive snaps
stories.summary: Miami is 0-5 and has not held a lead at any point this season. Malik Willis has taken every one of those snaps, and coach Jeff Hafley says he remains the starter. The Dolphins have scored 70 points, 31st in the league, and allowed 132.

stories.text: Willis practices fully; Taylor out, Beal doubtful
stories.summary: Friday's report lists CB Reese Taylor (quad) out and EDGE Rob Beal Jr. (hamstring) doubtful. S Kyle Louis (knee) and ILB Willie Gay Jr. (illness) are questionable. QB Willis (right thumb) practiced fully all week, and rookie WR Caleb Douglas (ankle) has no game designation.

stories.text: Willis does his damage with his legs
stories.summary: Willis has two touchdown passes and four interceptions in five games. He has also run for a career-high 186 yards, including 74 against Cincinnati, a franchise single-game record for a quarterback.

stories.text: 153.6: Miami's passing yards per game, 31st in the NFL
stories.summary: The Dolphins have rushed for 100 or more yards in each of their last four games, but the passing game has not kept up. Rookie WR Caleb Douglas had seven catches for 113 yards before leaving a game with an injury.

stories.text: At the Jets Sunday, 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Miami visits MetLife Stadium after its Week 6 bye, trying to avoid its fifth 0-6 start in franchise history. The Dolphins have won 10 of the last 12 meetings with New York. They host New England in Week 8.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.headline: Patriots fall in Chicago, 10th O-line combo in 7 games

stories.text: Bears beat Patriots 30-24 on Thursday night
stories.summary: New England fell to 4-3 at Soldier Field, ending a three-game win streak. Chicago led most of the night and Cairo Santos kicked a career-long 58-yard field goal late. Rhamondre Stevenson scored a 48-yard touchdown on the final play of the first half.

stories.text: Romeo Doubs goes to IR with a shoulder injury
stories.summary: Doubs hurt his shoulder landing on a touchdown catch against the Jets on Oct. 18 and will miss at least four games. Mike Vrabel would not give a timeline. He is the third Patriots receiver on IR, after A.J. Brown (earlier, since back) and Mack Hollins. Guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown were ruled out for the Bears game.

stories.text: Drake Maye throws for 321 yards in the loss
stories.summary: Maye went 24 of 31 for 321 yards and two touchdown passes, with one interception in the end zone. He also scored on the ground. The Patriots could not turn that into a win because the defense missed tackles and the run game stalled.

stories.text: 10: different offensive line combinations this season
stories.summary: Third-string guards started at left and right guard in Chicago, and right tackle Morgan Moses played on a bad foot. The Patriots posted a 20 percent rushing success rate against the Bears.

stories.text: Mini-bye, then at Miami on Nov. 1
stories.summary: New England plays the winless Dolphins in Miami in Week 8, on CBS with a 4:25 p.m. ET kickoff per the league schedule. The extra days give the offensive line a chance to get healthy.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.headline: Jets host Miami, 0-7 in AFC East under Glenn

stories.text: Jets host winless Miami and need a division win
stories.summary: New York is 2-4 after a 26-19 loss at New England and is 0-7 against AFC East teams under coach Aaron Glenn. Garrett Wilson called the Dolphins game huge. The Jets hold the league's fourth-ranked pass defense at 185 yards a game.

stories.text: Breece Hall questionable after limited practices
stories.summary: Hall has missed time since Week 3 with a right quad injury and was limited Thursday and Friday. LB Kiko Mauigoa, OL Max Mitchell and EDGE Joseph Ossai are out. OL Dylan Parham and RB Kene Nwangwu are questionable, and WR Adonai Mitchell practiced fully.

stories.text: Rookie David Bailey is making history early
stories.summary: Bailey is the only player since 1984 with 30 or more tackles, five or more sacks and at least one forced fumble through six career games. The rookie edge rusher anchors a defense that has allowed no points on opening drives in five straight games.

stories.text: 119-49: Jets outscored late in halves under Glenn
stories.summary: Under Glenn, New York has been outscored 119-49 in the closing minutes of the second and fourth quarters. The Jets also have 52 penalties through six games, fourth-most in the league, and went 0-for-3 in the red zone against New England.

stories.text: Home against Miami Sunday, 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: The Jets host the Dolphins at MetLife Stadium. Watch whether Hall reclaims the starting job from Braelon Allen, who has 253 rushing yards over the last three games. Miami has won 10 of the last 12 in the series.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.headline: Ravens wait on Lamar Jackson's ankle vs. Bengals

stories.text: Lamar Jackson is a game-time call against Cincinnati
stories.summary: Jackson (ankle) practiced on a limited basis all week and carries a questionable tag into Sunday. Baltimore lost to Cleveland last week with Tyler Huntley at quarterback and now faces an 0-2 start in the division if it loses again. The team says he practiced well enough to play.

stories.text: Tavius Robinson is out, Tampa doubtful for Bengals
stories.summary: Edge rusher Tavius Robinson (pectoral) is out and will miss the rest of the season, per one report. Safety Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) is out and cornerback T.J. Tampa Jr. (knee) is doubtful. Tackle Broderick Washington (ankle) is questionable. Ronnie Stanley sat Friday for rest, and Calais Campbell did the same.

stories.text: Derrick Henry needs a clean game after a rough Week 6
stories.summary: Henry ran 17 times for 58 yards in Cleveland and lost a fourth-quarter fumble, his first of the year. He still leads the league with 130 carries and has 534 yards and seven rushing touchdowns. Cincinnati ranks near the bottom against the run, and Baltimore wants its back to deliver.

stories.text: 10: points Baltimore scored in Cleveland, none after the first quarter
stories.summary: The Ravens scored all of their points early last Sunday, then went quiet. They have played three games this season without a second-half touchdown. Cam Jurgens makes his first start at center against Cincinnati's interior line.

stories.text: Bengals visit M&T Bank Stadium Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Baltimore hosts Cincinnati at 4-2 and 3-2. Watch the quarterback decision first, then whether Trey Hendrickson and the pass rush can slow Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins. The Ravens won the last meeting 24-0 in December.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.headline: Healthy Bengals return from bye to face Ravens

stories.text: Bengals come off the bye to face Baltimore at full strength
stories.summary: Cincinnati beat Miami 31-24 in Week 5 to snap a two-game losing streak, then rested. Chase and Higgins both played through injuries before the break. The Bengals head to Baltimore with Lamar Jackson's status still unclear.

stories.text: All 53 Bengals are available, Dugger back in the secondary
stories.summary: Cincinnati has no injury designations for Sunday. Safety Kyle Dugger (quad) practiced fully Thursday and Friday and plays his first game since Week 3. Jonathan Allen, B.J. Hill and Dexter Lawrence II took rest days Friday and are expected to play.

stories.text: Ja'Marr Chase has made Baltimore his favorite opponent
stories.summary: Chase averages 120.4 receiving yards in 10 games against the Ravens, the best mark any player has posted against one opponent in NFL history (minimum 10 games). He has topped 100 yards in his last four meetings. He also has four touchdown catches this season, tied for the AFC lead.

stories.text: 22: straight field goals made by Evan McPherson
stories.summary: McPherson's streak is the longest in Bengals history. Safety Jordan Battle is tied for the NFL lead with three interceptions. The offensive line has allowed three sacks over the last three games.

stories.text: Bengals at Ravens, Sunday 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Cincinnati needs a win to stay level with the three 4-2 teams atop the division. The defense faces Derrick Henry after allowing a season-high 217 rushing yards at Miami. Next up is Tennessee at home in Week 8.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.headline: Browns hold first place, head to Tennessee

stories.text: Browns own first place in the AFC North at 4-2
stories.summary: Andre Szmyt's 37-yard field goal beat Baltimore 13-10 last Sunday. Cleveland, Baltimore and Pittsburgh all sit at 4-2, but the Browns are 2-0 in the division. Todd Monken wants a faster start from the offense.

stories.text: Ward, Delpit and Williams are questionable for Tennessee
stories.summary: Cornerback Denzel Ward (hand) was limited Friday and Monken said he would probably play. Safety Grant Delpit (concussion, shoulder) could clear protocol as early as Saturday. Linebacker Quincy Williams (neck) is questionable. Guard Teven Jenkins and defensive tackles Kalia Davis and Mike Hall Jr. are out.

stories.text: Carson Schwesinger played through an ankle injury to lead Cleveland
stories.summary: Schwesinger made 13 tackles against Baltimore on a sore ankle. He forced a Derrick Henry fumble that Tyson Campbell recovered at the Ravens' 35. The defense has carried a Browns team that has not topped 30 points this season.

stories.text: 13: times Deshaun Watson has been sacked in two games
stories.summary: The Jets sacked Watson eight times in Week 5 and the Ravens added five more. Watson went 16 of 26 for 164 yards against Baltimore and ran eight times for 29. Protection is the question as Cleveland heads on the road.

stories.text: Browns at Titans, Sunday 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Tennessee is 1-5 and ranks last in the league in scoring, though it beat Indianapolis for its first win. Quinshon Judkins is expected back from an ankle injury. Cleveland visits Pittsburgh in Week 8.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.headline: Steelers play first NFL game in Paris Sunday

stories.text: Steelers take a two-game win streak to Paris
stories.summary: Pittsburgh meets New Orleans at Stade de France at 9:30 a.m. ET Sunday, the league's first Paris game. The Steelers are 4-2, the Saints 2-4. A Saints loss would drop them to 2-5 before their bye, and owner Gayle Benson has said she will not accept this level of performance.

stories.text: Rico Dowdle and DeShon Elliott are questionable in Paris
stories.summary: Running back Rico Dowdle (knee) was limited all week. Safety DeShon Elliott (knee) is questionable. Receiver Ben Skowronek (calf) and cornerback Brandin Echols (hamstring) are out. Rain and wind in the forecast canceled the Friday practice.

stories.text: Aaron Rodgers rallied Pittsburgh past Tampa Bay in overtime
stories.summary: Rodgers went 33 of 49 for 253 yards, two touchdowns and an interception in the 26-19 win. He led a 12-play, 70-yard overtime drive that ended with a 6-yard touchdown to Germie Bernard. It was his fourth career win after trailing by 13 or more entering the fourth quarter.

stories.text: 58: yards on Chris Boswell's tying field goal at Tampa Bay
stories.summary: Boswell's kick with 1:58 left tied the game at 16 after Tampa Bay led by 13 at halftime. He added a 20-yarder for the lead. The Steelers had a first road win and their first winning streak of the season.

stories.text: Steelers vs. Saints in Paris, Sunday 9:30 a.m. ET on NFL Network
stories.summary: Pittsburgh faces a Saints defense that allows the league's highest success rate on designed runs. Tyler Shough has five interceptions against zone coverage, and the Steelers play zone on about 83 percent of dropbacks. Cleveland comes to Pittsburgh in Week 8.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.headline: Texans ride two straight wins into Giants game

stories.text: Texans win in London on a last-second kick
stories.summary: Ka'imi Fairbairn hit a 49-yard field goal as time expired to beat Jacksonville 34-31 at Wembley. Houston is 2-4 with two straight wins. Marvin Harrison Jr. made his Texans debut after a trade from Arizona.

stories.text: Montgomery and three others out against the Giants
stories.summary: The Week 7 report lists running back David Montgomery (groin), tackle Blake Fisher (thumb) and safeties Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) and Jalen Pitre (shoulder) as out. Receiver Tank Dell (knee) is questionable.

stories.text: Stroud throws for 312 yards and three scores in London
stories.summary: C.J. Stroud went 24 of 34 for 312 yards, three touchdowns and one interception against Jacksonville. The pick was his first of the season, and he answered with the drive that set up Fairbairn's winner. Foster Moreau caught two of the touchdowns.

stories.text: 135.5: rushing yards per game the Giants allow
stories.summary: New York ranks 29th against the run, while its pass defense is fifth at 190.2 yards allowed per game. Houston's backfield is thin with Montgomery out, so watch how the Texans balance the run and Stroud's arm.

stories.text: Giants visit Houston on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: Houston hosts New York in Week 7, then has its bye in Week 8. J.J. McCarthy starts at quarterback for the Giants. The Texans' pass rush went sackless in London and wants a bounce-back day.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.headline: Colts fire Ballard, travel to unbeaten Vikings

stories.text: Colts fire GM Chris Ballard after loss to Titans
stories.summary: Co-owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon fired Ballard on Monday, a day after fans chanted for his exit during a 26-20 loss to the Titans, who had been winless. Assistant GM Ed Dodds handles personnel moves while a search runs. Coach Shane Steichen stays, and Daniel Jones remains the starter.

stories.text: Warren, Gardner and Gould out at Minnesota
stories.summary: Tight end Tyler Warren (groin), cornerback Sauce Gardner (calf) and receiver Anthony Gould (concussion) are out. Linebackers CJ Allen (ankle) and Bryce Boettcher (groin), cornerback Justin Walley (knee) and punter Rigoberto Sanchez (right foot) are questionable.

stories.text: Taylor piles up 151 yards in a losing effort
stories.summary: Jonathan Taylor ran for 94 yards and a touchdown and added 57 receiving yards against Tennessee. He also lost a fumble on the first play of the second half, which Jeffery Simmons forced. Keenan Allen caught eight passes for 82 yards.

stories.text: 1,029: yards the Colts allowed in their first two games
stories.summary: That was the second-highest two-game total in league history, according to AP. The defense has been a problem all season, and the Colts are 2-4 and have lost two in a row.

stories.text: Colts visit the 5-0 Vikings on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Indianapolis opens a two-game road trip at U.S. Bank Stadium, then plays at Jacksonville. Minnesota is coming off its Week 6 bye. The next Colts home game is Nov. 8 against Dallas.

teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.headline: Jaguars on bye with a tight AFC South lead

stories.text: Jaguars hit the bye after a London loss
stories.summary: Jacksonville enters its Week 7 bye at 4-2 after a 34-31 loss to Houston at Wembley. Coach Liam Coen has penalties and a leaky pass defense to fix. The team still holds a two-game lead in the AFC South, per the club.

stories.text: Anton Harrison out with a knee injury
stories.summary: Walker Little started at left tackle in Harrison's place against Houston. Cornerback Montaric Brown (hamstring) has missed two of the last three games. Long snapper Ross Matiscik (shoulder) was ruled out in London and Jacob Bobenmoyer replaced him.

stories.text: Travis Hunter scores a touchdown and picks off a pass
stories.summary: Hunter caught two touchdowns and intercepted C.J. Stroud in the end zone against Houston. AP says he is the fifth player in the Super Bowl era to score and intercept in one game. Trevor Lawrence went 24 of 41 for 306 yards and four touchdowns.

stories.text: 273.8: passing yards allowed per game, 30th in the NFL
stories.summary: The Jaguars have given up about 320 per game over the last three weeks. Stroud hit completions of 34, 42 and 50 yards in London. Safety Eric Murray says communication is the biggest fix.

stories.text: Bye this week, then the Colts on Nov. 1 at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Jacksonville is off in Week 7 and hosts Indianapolis in Week 8. The Colts fired their GM this week.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.headline: Titans get first win, host Browns

stories.text: Titans rally past Colts for first win of 2026
stories.summary: Tennessee erased a 13-0 halftime deficit to win 26-20. A Chimere Dike punt return set up a Cam Ward touchdown pass to Carnell Tate, and a blocked punt became a defensive touchdown. Joey Slye added second-half field goals.

stories.text: Five Titans questionable, none out
stories.summary: Running back Tyjae Spears (knee), receiver Calvin Ridley (hip), linebacker Dorian Mausi (foot) and safeties Tony Adams (ankle) and Kevin Winston Jr. (quad) are questionable for Cleveland.

stories.text: Rookie Carnell Tate leads Tennessee with 344 yards
stories.summary: Tate has 29 catches for 344 yards and caught his first NFL touchdown against Indianapolis, an 8-yarder from Ward. He had six catches for 70 yards in the win.

stories.text: 6: sacks of Daniel Jones in the win over Indianapolis
stories.summary: Tennessee's defense also forced three takeaways. Jeffery Simmons forced a fumble by Jonathan Taylor on the first play of the second half. The Titans have 16 sacks on the season, ninth in the league.

stories.text: Browns visit Nashville on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Cleveland has 19 sacks, second in the NFL, and Ward threw for only 102 yards last week. Tennessee's pass rush faces Deshaun Watson, who has been sacked 24 times, the most in the league.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.headline: Broncos win ugly, offense still searching

stories.text: Broncos are 4-2 with the league's 31st offense
stories.summary: Denver beat Seattle 17-14 in overtime after leading 14-3, then went 0-for-6 on third down after halftime and gained 30 yards in the second half. The defense keeps winning games for a team that ranks 31st in total yards. Sean Payton says the fix starts with him and the plays he calls.

stories.text: Surtain and Coleman questionable, three Broncos out
stories.summary: Cornerback Patrick Surtain II was limited all week with an ankle injury and is questionable. Running back Jonah Coleman is questionable and his return from injured reserve is underway. Tyler Badie (thumb), Jonah Elliss (ankle) and Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) are out. Linebacker Jonathon Cooper is expected back from the commissioner's exempt list this week.

stories.text: Bo Nix is 33 of 54 for 230 yards since Oct. 8
stories.summary: Nix has thrown for 230 yards across Denver's last two wins, and his longest completion against Seattle was 16 yards. His average depth of target is 6.3 yards, 33rd among 35 qualified quarterbacks. Payton wants to give him more chances downfield.

stories.text: 22 of 65: Denver's third-down conversions through five games
stories.summary: That is a 33.8 percent conversion rate. The Broncos went 1 of 12 on third down in the win at Los Angeles and 0 for 6 after halftime against Seattle. Denver's defense ranks ninth in EPA per play and has forced 10 turnovers.

stories.text: Broncos visit Cardinals Sunday at 4:05 ET on CBS
stories.summary: Denver (4-2) plays at State Farm Stadium against Arizona (2-4). The Cardinals allowed 30 or more points in four straight games before holding the Rams to 16. Watch whether Payton opens up the passing game against the league's 28th-ranked defense in yards per play. Denver hosts Kansas City in Week 8.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.headline: Unbeaten Chiefs head to Seattle short on weapons

stories.text: Unbeaten Chiefs visit Seattle on Sunday night
stories.summary: Kansas City has won five straight and plays at Lumen Field on NBC at 8:20 ET. The game is the first return to Seattle for running back Kenneth Walker III, the Super Bowl LX MVP who left the Seahawks in free agency. Coach Andy Reid says Walker is wired for the moment.

stories.text: Rice, Moore and Smith out; Sneed questionable
stories.summary: Wide receiver Rashee Rice (hamstring and knee), tackle Jaylon Moore (concussion) and running back Brashard Smith (hamstring) are out. Cornerback L'Jarius Sneed and linebacker Cooper McDonald, both with knee injuries, are questionable. Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce are on the report but carry no game designation, and Mahomes practiced fully.

stories.text: Kenneth Walker leads the NFL with 665 rushing yards
stories.summary: Walker has 665 yards and six touchdowns on 106 carries in five games, about 6.3 yards a carry. He ran for 128 yards and two scores against the Chargers last Sunday. He said he wants to fix Kansas City's mistakes first and will deal with the reunion after that.

stories.text: 0: Mahomes touchdown passes in the win over the Chargers
stories.summary: It was the first game this season Mahomes did not throw a touchdown pass. Kansas City still won 22-6 behind Walker and converted 3 of 10 third downs. Mahomes had thrown for 1,309 yards, nine touchdowns and three interceptions through the first five games.

stories.text: Chiefs at Seahawks, Sunday 8:20 ET on NBC
stories.summary: Kansas City plays at Lumen Field without Rice, whose last game was Week 4. With Rice out, Kelce could see more targets, and Jaydn Ott is expected to be elevated from the practice squad at running back. The Chiefs visit Denver in Week 8.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.headline: Raiders try to end three-game skid vs. Rams

stories.text: Raiders look to snap a three-game losing streak
stories.summary: Las Vegas is 3-3 after a 33-30 loss to Buffalo in which it was outscored 10-0 in the third quarter. Coach Klint Kubiak says the run game still needs work. The Raiders host the Rams on Sunday.

stories.text: Only Mike Washington questionable for Rams
stories.summary: Running back Mike Washington (foot and back) did not practice Friday and is questionable. Tight end Brock Bowers (hamstring and calf) and defensive tackle Tonka Hemingway (concussion) were full participants and carry no designation. Tight end Carter Runyon and receiver Dont'e Thornton Jr. returned from injured reserve and are listed out.

stories.text: Brock Bowers chases a tight end record
stories.summary: Bowers needs 18 receptions to pass Trey McBride's 221 for the most by a tight end in his first three seasons. He is a full participant after a hamstring and calf issue. Maxx Crosby needs 5.0 sacks to reach seven or more for an eighth straight season.

stories.text: 10: Raiders takeaways, most in the NFL
stories.summary: The defense leads the league in takeaways but missed the mark in two of its last three games. Las Vegas has also gone 2 for 5 in the red zone against Buffalo. The Raiders rank 30th in rushing offense at 79.2 yards a game.

stories.text: Raiders host Rams Sunday at 4:25 ET on Fox
stories.summary: Las Vegas faces a Rams team that is 2-4 but ranks second in passing at 288.7 yards a game. Matthew Stafford leads the league with 1,794 passing yards. The Raiders then travel to face the Jets in Week 8.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.headline: Winless Chargers review everything on bye

stories.text: 0-6 Chargers put the offense under review
stories.summary: Jim Harbaugh said every change is possible after the Chargers fell to 0-6 and said the review starts with him. Offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel has taken much of the blame for Justin Herbert's decline. The team is considering a simpler playbook during the bye.

stories.text: Alt, James and Harris targeted for Week 8 return
stories.summary: The Chargers hope to get tackle Joe Alt (neck), safety Derwin James (hamstring) and receiver Tre' Harris (hamstring) back after the bye. Offensive line injuries have forced the team to use four rookies in pass protection at times.

stories.text: Herbert has 8 interceptions and 21 sacks taken
stories.summary: Herbert is completing 59.4 percent of his passes, well below his 66.1 percent career mark. He has five touchdowns and 10 turnovers, and he has been under pressure on a league-high 99 dropbacks. Nine of the 21 sacks came in the last two games.

stories.text: -0.190: Chargers EPA per play, last in the NFL
stories.summary: The offense sits behind the 31st-ranked Titans at -0.127 and averages 15.0 points a game. In the 22-6 loss at Kansas City, it settled for field goals on both trips inside the 20 and ran 17 plays for 38 yards during one stretch.

stories.text: Bye this week, then at the Rams on Nov. 1
stories.summary: Los Angeles is off in Week 7 and cannot earn its first win before Nov. 1, when it plays at the Rams at 4:05 ET on Fox. Houston visits Nov. 8. The defense under Chris O'Leary has 10 takeaways and is the unit to watch, though it has struggled against the run.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.headline: Cowboys need answers on offense in Philly

stories.text: Cowboys offense stalls as Jones backs Schottenheimer
stories.summary: Dallas has scored 29 points in back-to-back losses to Tampa Bay and Green Bay. Dak Prescott threw for 258 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in the 23-13 loss at Green Bay, and the Cowboys have scored under 20 in consecutive games for the first time since 2019. Jerry Jones said Friday he is confident in Brian Schottenheimer, and Schottenheimer said he will not give up play calling.

stories.text: Pickens, Overshown and Durant full on Friday
stories.summary: George Pickens (shoulder), LB DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring) and CB Cobie Durant (hamstring) all practiced fully Friday. Receiver KaVontae Turpin (ribs), LB Dee Winters (calf) and tackle Drew Shelton (hamstring) did not practice. Tackle Broderick Jones (wrist) and safety P.J. Locke (foot) were limited.

stories.text: CeeDee Lamb passes Tony Hill on Cowboys receiving list
stories.summary: Lamb caught nine of 18 targets for 70 yards in the loss at Green Bay. That put him at 7,993 career receiving yards with Dallas, third in franchise history. His 48 catches rank third in the NFL, but a slip on a route led to an interception in the loss.

stories.text: 7: Javonte Williams' rushing touchdowns in six games
stories.summary: Williams has seven rushing touchdowns through six games, the second most in Cowboys history at that point. Emmitt Smith had 11 in 1995. Dallas as a team ran for only 48 yards on 3.2 yards per carry at Green Bay.

stories.text: At Eagles, Monday at 8:15 PM ET on ESPN
stories.summary: Dallas visits a Philadelphia team that is also 2-4 and playing without Jalen Hurts. The Eagles rank 27th in yards allowed at 363.8 per game. Dallas won the last meeting 24-21 on Nov. 23, 2025, and its own defense has allowed 4.7 yards per carry.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.headline: McCarthy gets the nod at QB against Houston

stories.text: J.J. McCarthy named Giants starter over Winston
stories.summary: John Harbaugh picked McCarthy to start Sunday at Houston, with Jameis Winston as the backup and Jake Haener the emergency third. McCarthy came in against New Orleans and went 11 of 21 for 243 yards, one touchdown and one interception. Harbaugh did not commit to him beyond this game. Jaxson Dart is out with a season-ending knee injury.

stories.text: Edmunds and Newsome out at Houston
stories.summary: LB Tremaine Edmunds (shoulder) and CB Greg Newsome II (concussion) are out. TE Theo Johnson (neck) is doubtful. Tackle Jermaine Eluemunor, safety Jevon Holland, lineman Marcus Mbow, safety Tyler Nubin and cornerback Paulson Adebo are questionable. Left tackle Andrew Thomas (groin) was limited Friday and has no game designation.

stories.text: Malik Nabers piles up 165 yards against Saints
stories.summary: Nabers caught 12 passes for 165 yards in the 34-27 loss to New Orleans, his third straight game over 100 yards. Over those three games he has 29 catches for 398 yards. He also passed Puka Nacua for the second most catches through a player's first 25 games, with 168. Only Odell Beckham Jr. has more, at 176.

stories.text: 1950: Last time two Giants QBs threw for 150 yards
stories.summary: Winston (152 yards) and McCarthy (243) both cleared 150 passing yards against the Saints. The Giants had not had two players do that in one game since 1950. New York also scored 17 unanswered points in the final 11 minutes before the last drive ended at the Saints' 14.

stories.text: At Texans, Sunday at 1 PM ET on Fox
stories.summary: The Giants lead the NFC East at 3-2-1 and face a Houston team that is 2-4 but has won two straight. New York has won five straight against the Texans, going back to 2006. The Giants have their bye next week.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.headline: Hurts on IR as the Eagles lose four straight

stories.text: Hurts on injured reserve, McKee takes over
stories.summary: Jalen Hurts went on injured reserve with a superficial blood clot in his calf. NFL.com reported he would miss at least a month, and the AP says he is expected to miss the rest of the season. Hurts had 933 passing yards, eight touchdowns and three interceptions. The Eagles have lost four straight, their first such skid since 2020.

stories.text: Smith, Goedert sat Friday; Barkley limited
stories.summary: WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and TE Dallas Goedert (knee) did not practice Friday. RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) was limited and might return after missing two-plus games. OLB Jonathan Greenard (ankle) and OLB Nolan Smith (concussion) also did not practice.

stories.text: Tanner McKee faces his first full week as the starter
stories.summary: McKee threw for 215 yards on nearly 50 attempts in the 25-14 loss to Carolina, with under 20 yards after the first quarter. He now gets a full week of practice with first-year offensive coordinator Sean Mannion. He had 597 yards, five touchdowns and one interception in six career games before Carolina.

stories.text: 58: Points the Eagles scored in four straight losses
stories.summary: Philadelphia has put up 58 points during the skid and has committed 10 or more penalties three times. To finish with a sixth straight winning season under Nick Sirianni, the Eagles must go 7-4 the rest of the way.

stories.text: Cowboys at the Linc, Monday at 8:15 PM ET on ESPN
stories.summary: The Eagles host Dallas in a game between two 2-4 teams, then visit Washington on Nov. 1 and host the Giants. Watch the Eagles' running game against a Dallas defense allowing 4.7 yards per carry.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.headline: McLaurin lost for the year as Commanders rest

stories.text: Terry McLaurin out for season with torn patellar tendon
stories.summary: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon in the 23-17 loss at San Francisco and needs surgery. He had 15 catches for 230 yards and one touchdown in five games. Stefon Diggs and rookie Antonio Williams are expected to take on bigger roles. His contract also raises questions about his future in Washington.

stories.text: Croskey-Merritt, Jean-Baptiste to IR during bye
stories.summary: Washington placed Croskey-Merritt and Jean-Baptiste on injured reserve and activated Amos, Magee and McNichols. McLaurin is done for the year. The Commanders are on their bye, which gives other banged-up players time to heal.

stories.text: Jayden Daniels throws for 300 yards in the loss
stories.summary: Daniels threw for 300 yards and two touchdowns on 29 completions against the 49ers, with no interceptions. His scores went to Stefon Diggs from one yard and Rachaad White from nine. The Commanders still lost 23-17 after falling behind 23-3.

stories.text: 224-72: Washington's second-half yardage edge
stories.summary: After a first half in which San Francisco dominated, Washington outgained the 49ers 224 to 72 after the break. The rally cut a 23-3 deficit to one score but fell short.

stories.text: Bye in Week 7, then Eagles at home Nov. 1
stories.summary: Washington is off this weekend. It returns Nov. 1 at 8:20 PM ET on NBC against Philadelphia, the first of back-to-back home games. Washington then hosts the Rams on Nov. 8.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.headline: Bears beat Pats, then lose Kmet for the year

stories.text: Bears outlast Patriots 30-24 to reach 5-2
stories.summary: Chicago beat New England on Thursday night at Soldier Field, its first home win over the Patriots since 2000. The Bears led 20-14 at the half and held a 27-21 edge after the teams traded touchdowns coming out of the break. Cairo Santos then hit a 58-yard field goal with 1:34 left, and Rome Odunze recovered an onside kick to close it out.

stories.text: Kmet placed on injured reserve with knee injury
stories.summary: Tight end Cole Kmet was hurt in the fourth quarter after a collision with two Patriots defenders and was carted off. Coach Ben Johnson announced Friday that the Bears put him on season-ending injured reserve after testing showed he could not bear weight. Colston Loveland and rookie Sam Roush take on bigger roles. Johnson said the offense will not change how it uses its tight ends.

stories.text: Burden III goes for 130 yards on four catches
stories.summary: Luther Burden III caught four passes for 130 yards and a 24-yard touchdown against New England. Caleb Williams, in his second game back from a three-game hamstring absence, threw for 308 yards and two scores. Colston Loveland added seven catches for 69 yards and a touchdown.

stories.text: 2018: Last time a Bears QB had back-to-back 300-yard games
stories.summary: Caleb Williams threw for 308 yards against the Patriots after 305 against Atlanta the week before. He is the first Bears quarterback with consecutive 300-yard games since Mitchell Trubisky in 2018. Williams completed 22 of 33 passes against New England with no interceptions.

stories.text: Bears head to Seattle for Monday Night Football
stories.summary: Chicago plays at Seattle on Monday, Nov. 2, on ESPN, after a mini-bye. The Seahawks, the defending champions, have the NFL's top defense in fewest yards allowed per game, and Kenneth Walker is out. Watch how the Bears fill the Kmet hole against that unit.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.headline: Lions open NFC North play against Packers

stories.text: Lions come off the bye for their first division game
stories.summary: Detroit hosts Green Bay on Sunday in its first NFC North game of the season, and the Lions sit last in the division at 3-2. Minnesota leads at 5-0, with Green Bay and Chicago at 4-2 when the week began. Safety Brian Branch and center Cade Mays are expected back, per coach Dan Campbell.

stories.text: Branch and Mays questionable but full all week
stories.summary: Safety Brian Branch (Achilles) and center Cade Mays (wrist) were full participants in practice Wednesday through Friday and carry questionable tags. Cornerback Rock Ya-Sin (hamstring) was limited early in the week and went full Friday with no game designation. Branch's workload remains managed as he returns from the torn Achilles.

stories.text: Gibbs enters the Packers game on a historic pace
stories.summary: Jahmyr Gibbs became the fifth player in NFL history with 700 scrimmage yards and nine touchdowns through his team's first five games. He has forced 45 missed tackles and has 18 runs of 10 or more yards. Green Bay has held him under 70 rushing yards in all six meetings since 2023, so Matt LaFleur's defense knows the test.

stories.text: 32nd: Where the Lions rank in total defense
stories.summary: Detroit has the NFL's fourth-ranked offense but the league's worst total defense. Green Bay ranks 10th in total defense and 18th in total offense. Branch's return gives the secondary one more body against Jordan Love and the Packers' deep targets.

stories.text: Packers visit Ford Field Sunday at 4:25 p.m. ET
stories.summary: Detroit hosts Green Bay on Sunday, Oct. 25, at 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX. Watch Aidan Hutchinson, who has 32 pressures in five games, against a Packers line with uncertain guard depth. Jared Goff has 12 touchdown passes and no interceptions, and Green Bay leads the league in interceptions.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.headline: Packers ride three straight wins into Detroit

stories.text: Packers take a three-game streak to Detroit
stories.summary: Green Bay is 4-2 and has won three in a row, the latest a 23-13 win over Dallas on Sunday Night Football. Before that came a 31-7 win over Chicago on Oct. 11. The Packers now face a Lions team coming off its bye and ranked last in the league in total defense.

stories.text: Franklin out with shin injury; four questionable
stories.summary: Linebacker Zaire Franklin took a knee to the shin in a collision at Thursday's practice and is out Sunday, ending a 48-game streak. Guard Aaron Banks, cornerback Benjamin St-Juste, receiver Bo Melton and defensive tackle Jordon Riley (Achilles, on PUP) are questionable. Quarterback Jordan Love (back) was a full participant Thursday and Friday with no designation.

stories.text: Love leads the NFL on deep throws
stories.summary: Jordan Love leads the league in passing yards on throws of 10 or more and 20 or more air yards, and drops have held those totals down. Detroit allows the most EPA per play on 20-plus air-yard throws. Christian Watson, Matthew Golden and Tucker Kraft are the likely deep targets.

stories.text: 22: Offensive snaps Aaron Banks has played this year
stories.summary: The guard has played 22 snaps, all in Week 2 against the Jets, before a toe injury and knee tendinitis sidelined him. He is questionable for Sunday after being limited all three days this week. Laken Tomlinson has started the last three games at left guard.

stories.text: Packers at Lions, Sunday 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Green Bay visits Ford Field on Sunday, Oct. 25. Isaiah McDuffie, Ty'Ron Hopper and Nick Niemann cover for Franklin, and Edgerrin Cooper has been out since a Week 5 Achilles tear. Coleman Owen is likely to be elevated from the practice squad because the receiver room is thin.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.headline: Unbeaten Vikings face a Colts trap game

stories.text: Vikings put a 10-game win streak on the line
stories.summary: Minnesota is 5-0 and owns the NFL's longest active win streak at 10 games. The Colts come to U.S. Bank Stadium at 2-4 after blowing a 13-0 halftime lead against Tennessee. A win sets up a tough stretch: at Detroit, Buffalo on Monday night, at Green Bay, then San Francisco in Mexico City.

stories.text: Mason questionable; Darrisaw did not practice Friday
stories.summary: Running back Jordan Mason (thumb) is questionable after full practices all week. Tackle Christian Darrisaw sat out Friday with a concussion and rest designation after two full days. Justin Jefferson (ankle), Brian O'Neill (knee) and James Pierre (foot) were limited Wednesday and full Thursday and Friday. Colts corner Sauce Gardner, receiver Anthony Gould and tight end Tyler Warren are out.

stories.text: Murray starts 12 for 12 in win over Saints
stories.summary: Kyler Murray opened the 23-13 win at New Orleans with 12 straight completions, a personal best and tied for second in franchise history. He went 19 of 20 on throws within 10 yards and hit 3 of 4 passes 20 or more yards downfield, one a touchdown to Justin Jefferson. He also scrambled seven times for 54 yards.

stories.text: +6: Vikings turnover margin leads the NFL
stories.summary: Minnesota's plus-6 turnover margin is the best in the league, while Indianapolis sits at minus-8, the worst. Colts quarterback Daniel Jones has nine turnovers, six interceptions and three lost fumbles. The Vikings also allow the fewest points in the NFL, 12.8 per game.

stories.text: Colts visit U.S. Bank Stadium Sunday at 1 p.m. ET
stories.summary: Minnesota hosts Indianapolis on Sunday, Oct. 25, at 1 p.m. ET on CBS. Watch Jonathan Taylor, who has 492 rushing yards and seven rushing touchdowns, against a Vikings run defense allowing 86.6 yards per game through Week 5. Minnesota visits Detroit next.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.headline: Falcons chase an upset of undefeated San Francisco

stories.text: Falcons add Andy Dalton as emergency quarterback
stories.summary: Atlanta signed Andy Dalton on Monday and released Cooper Rush. Dalton is expected to sit third on the depth chart behind Michael Penix Jr. and Tua Tagovailoa. The Falcons have lost two straight and host the 6-0 49ers on Sunday.

stories.text: Falcons list Bowman out, three DBs in question
stories.summary: Per The Game Haus, safety Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring), running back Brian Robinson Jr., linebacker Divine Deablo and tackle Michael Jerrell are out. Cornerback A.J. Terrell Jr. practiced fully Friday but must come off injured reserve to play. C.J. Henderson and Avieon Terrell are questionable.

stories.text: Bijan Robinson leads the NFL in scrimmage yards
stories.summary: Robinson has 758 scrimmage yards through six games, including 641 on the ground, second in the league. He is the engine of an offense that has scored 23 points in each of its last two losses.

stories.text: 9: times Penix has been sacked in four starts
stories.summary: Michael Penix Jr. is 2-2 as a starter this season and 6-10 overall. He took five sacks and fumbled twice against Chicago last Sunday. San Francisco has 15 sacks after a league-low 20 all of last season.

stories.text: 49ers at Falcons, Sunday 1:00 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: San Francisco arrives 6-0 with former Falcons coach Raheem Morris running its defense. Atlanta is trying to avoid a third straight loss. Watch Penix's pocket against Keion White and Osa Odighizuwa. The Falcons visit Tampa Bay on Nov. 1.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.headline: Panthers lead NFC South behind Bryce Young's arm

stories.text: Panthers sit 2.5 games clear in the NFC South
stories.summary: Carolina is 3-2 and leads the division, with Atlanta and New Orleans at 2-4 and Tampa Bay at 1-5. Bryce Young is having a breakout year, and the Panthers bring the league's top passing offense into Sunday's home game against the Bucs.

stories.text: Phillips and Incoom out, Freeling questionable
stories.summary: Edge rushers Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and Thomas Incoom (calf) are out against Tampa Bay. Rookie tackle Monroe Freeling (knee) is questionable after three full practices. Linebacker Bam Martin-Scott has started his practice window but is not active.

stories.text: Chuba Hubbard ran for 120 yards against Philadelphia
stories.summary: Hubbard has 511 scrimmage yards and leads Carolina with 426 rushing yards and six touchdowns. He was a full participant Thursday and Friday after a rest designation.

stories.text: 309.8: Bryce Young's passing yards per game
stories.summary: Young leads the NFL in passing yards per game through five starts, with 11 touchdowns and two interceptions. He averaged 188.2 last season. He has also been sacked 12 times.

stories.text: Buccaneers at Panthers, Sunday 1:00 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: Carolina is a 3.5-point favorite at Bank of America Stadium. The Panthers' run defense ranks last in yards per carry allowed at 5.12, and Tampa Bay ranks second in run defense. Carolina plays at Green Bay on Thursday night, Oct. 29.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.headline: Saints cross the Atlantic with pressure building

stories.text: Saints face owner pressure ahead of Paris game
stories.summary: Owner Gayle Benson said she will not accept the team's current level of play as the standard. New Orleans was 1-4 before beating the Giants 34-27 in Week 6. GM Mickey Loomis says he likes the direction under second-year coach Kellen Moore.

stories.text: Ruiz and Shepherd questionable for Pittsburgh
stories.summary: Guard Cesar Ruiz (knee) and defensive lineman Nathan Shepherd (illness and rest) are questionable on the Friday report. Quarterback Tyler Shough practiced fully all week with a left hand listed on the report.

stories.text: Tyler Shough has 14 touchdowns, four against the Giants
stories.summary: Shough is tied for third in the NFL in offensive touchdowns. He also has eight giveaways, tied for fourth, and five interceptions against zone coverage, tied for second most.

stories.text: 12: Saints giveaways, tied for third most in the NFL
stories.summary: New Orleans faces a Pittsburgh defense with 10 takeaways, tied for third. Five of the Steelers' six interceptions came against zone coverage, which they play on 82.8 percent of dropbacks.

stories.text: Steelers vs. Saints in Paris, Sunday 9:30 a.m. ET on NFL Network
stories.summary: The Saints play at Stade de France in the NFL's first Paris game. Pittsburgh is 4-2. New Orleans takes its bye in Week 8, then hosts Cleveland on Nov. 8.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.headline: Baker Mayfield set to return against Carolina

stories.text: Baker Mayfield will start after three missed games
stories.summary: Coach Todd Bowles said Mayfield will start Sunday at Carolina. He practiced fully all week with a dislocated right thumb and will wear a glove. Tampa Bay is 1-5 and last in the NFC South, and went 0-3 with Mayfield before the injury.

stories.text: Egbuka, Goedeke and Winfield out against Carolina
stories.summary: Receiver Emeka Egbuka, tackle Luke Goedeke and safety Antoine Winfield Jr. are out. Mayfield is questionable but expected to play. Linebacker Christian Rozeboom went on injured reserve and will miss at least four games.

stories.text: David Walker posted his first two-sack game
stories.summary: Walker leads Tampa Bay with 4.0 sacks, including two in the overtime loss to Pittsburgh. He ranks first among qualifying edge rushers in sack rate at 8.2 percent. Another multi-sack game would be the first back-to-back for a Buccaneer since Jason Pierre-Paul.

stories.text: 164.8: Tampa Bay's passing yards per game, 30th in the NFL
stories.summary: The Bucs rank 30th in passing offense and eighth in rushing at 127.8 yards per game. Jalon Daniels was sacked five times and threw two interceptions against Pittsburgh.

stories.text: Buccaneers at Panthers, Sunday 1:00 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: Carolina has the league's top passing offense, led by Bryce Young. Tampa Bay has won 10 of the last 12 meetings. The Bucs host Atlanta on Nov. 1, then take their bye in Week 10.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.headline: Cardinals face Broncos on a thin roster

stories.text: Cardinals stun Rams on last-second field goal
stories.summary: Arizona beat Los Angeles 18-16 at SoFi Stadium as a double-digit underdog. Jalen Brooks made a late catch to set up Chad Ryland's winning kick. Jacoby Brissett now says defenses will play man coverage against Arizona every week.

stories.text: Love sits again as four Cardinals are ruled out
stories.summary: Rookie running back Jeremiyah Love (ankle), defensive lineman Walter Nolen III (ankle), safety Andrew Wingard (knee) and guard Jon Gaines II (knee/ankle) are out against Denver. Safety Budda Baker (groin/illness), quarterback Carson Beck (back), cornerback Max Melton (knee) and lineman Darius Robinson (back) are questionable.

stories.text: Bam Knight leads the backfield while Love heals
stories.summary: Knight ran 15 times for 80 yards against the Rams. He has 112 yards on 18 carries this season, a 6.2 average. Arizona ran for a season-high 120 yards as a team, and Knight and Tyler Allgeier will share the work again.

stories.text: 0: touchdown passes for Brissett in the win
stories.summary: Jacoby Brissett went 24 of 35 for 218 yards with one interception, his first game this season without a touchdown pass. He still moved the offense into field goal range six times. His season line is nine touchdowns and six interceptions.

stories.text: Broncos visit Sunday, Fitzgerald honored at halftime
stories.summary: Arizona hosts Denver on Sunday at 4:05 p.m. ET on CBS. The Cardinals retire Larry Fitzgerald's number at halftime. Watch whether Denver, 4-2, can slow the Cardinals' passing game while Love and Gaines sit.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.headline: Rams hit the road with a thinned-out roster

stories.text: Rams lose 18-16 after a flag helps Arizona
stories.summary: Los Angeles led 16-15 with 47 seconds left on an 86-yard drive. Then Josh Wallace drew an unnecessary roughness flag on a 21-yard catch, and Chad Ryland kicked a 43-yard field goal as time expired. The Rams are 2-4 and last in the NFC West on tiebreakers.

stories.text: Nacua and McDuffie questionable, Landman out
stories.summary: Wide receiver Puka Nacua (calf) left Thursday's practice early and did not practice Friday. Cornerback Trent McDuffie (groin) sat out all week. Linebacker Nate Landman (concussion) is out, and Eric Kendricks moves up from the practice squad.

stories.text: Nacua must carry the receiver room
stories.summary: Nacua leads the Rams with 37 catches even after missing two games. Davante Adams hurt his hamstring in the loss and Sean McVay expects him out 6 to 10 weeks. Before the injury Adams had 30 catches for 480 yards and four touchdowns.

stories.text: 299.0: Stafford's passing yards per game
stories.summary: Matthew Stafford averages 299.0 yards through the air but has thrown six interceptions. Los Angeles is 3-7 against the spread in its last 10 games. The Raiders sit 26th in net yards per play in one writer's rankings.

stories.text: Rams visit Raiders Sunday at 4:25 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: Los Angeles, 2-4, plays Las Vegas, 3-3, at Allegiant Stadium. Watch the receiver rotation with Adams out and Nacua unsettled, plus how the Rams handle Kirk Cousins with Kobie Turner and Poona Ford out. The Rams' bye comes in Week 11.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.headline: Undefeated 49ers go to Atlanta without Bosa, Evans

stories.text: 49ers hold off Washington to reach 6-0
stories.summary: San Francisco beat the Commanders 23-17 on Monday night for its first 6-0 start since 2019. The offense gained 303 net yards in the first half, then slowed after Mike Evans left. The defense sacked Jayden Daniels four times.

stories.text: Six 49ers ruled out, Bosa and Evans among them
stories.summary: Defensive end Nick Bosa (knee, calf) has missed four games and the team hopes he returns after the bye. Wide receiver Mike Evans (ribs, Achilles tendinitis) and Deebo Samuel (hamstring) are also out. Christian Kirk (calf) is questionable and expected to come off injured reserve Saturday.

stories.text: Purdy keeps efficiency up without his top receivers
stories.summary: Brock Purdy went 21 of 29 for 264 yards and a touchdown against Washington. He played the second half without his top six receivers, who were out or hurt by halftime. His career passer rating is now the best in NFL history among players with at least 1,500 attempts.

stories.text: 30: touchdown connections between Purdy and Kittle
stories.summary: Brock Purdy and George Kittle tied Alex Smith and Vernon Davis for the most quarterback to tight end touchdowns in franchise history. Kittle's score against Washington was his 57th career receiving touchdown, fourth in team history.

stories.text: 49ers visit Falcons Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: San Francisco, 6-0, plays Atlanta, 2-4, at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Raheem Morris, fired by the Falcons, returns as 49ers defensive coordinator. The 49ers have a bye in Week 8, then host Las Vegas.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.headline: Seahawks rework offense before Chiefs on Sunday night

stories.text: Seahawks retool offense after overtime loss to Denver
stories.summary: Seattle lost 17-14 in overtime Thursday night and sits at 3-3. Sam Darnold has seven interceptions in four games since returning from a glute injury. Mike Macdonald will lead offensive meetings, signed tight end Josiah Deguara and fullback Jackson Acker, and has said he is not planning to replace Darnold.

stories.text: Arroyo to IR, Price out, Bradford may return
stories.summary: Tight end Elijah Arroyo went on injured reserve with a shoulder injury from the Denver game. Running back Jadarian Price (chest) is out against Kansas City. Right guard Anthony Bradford, who has missed every game but the opener, has a good chance to return, Macdonald said.

stories.text: Darnold takes a beating behind a leaky line
stories.summary: Denver sacked Darnold five times, hit him 17 times and pressured him on 46.6 percent of his dropbacks, per Pro Football Focus. He threw two interceptions, including the overtime pick that set up Wil Lutz's 53-yard winning kick. He called the turnovers unacceptable.

stories.text: 3.96: yards per play the Seahawks defense allows
stories.summary: Seattle has allowed 3.96 yards per play through six games, the best mark for any NFL defense since 2008. Denver managed 168 total yards and 2.9 yards per play on Thursday and still won. The offense had three points and 189 yards through the first 50 minutes.

stories.text: Chiefs visit Sunday night at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC
stories.summary: Seattle, 3-3, hosts unbeaten Kansas City, 5-0, at Lumen Field. Former Seahawk Kenneth Walker III leads the Chiefs' run game. Seattle ranks last in rush EPA, so watch the ground game and the pressure on Darnold.
